2018-02-00 - STONE HILL STUDIO, COLTS NECK, NJ

SEPTEMBER KISSES / JANEY NEEDS A SHOOTER

Springsteen held recording sessions at his home studio throughout 2018 and into 2019 at which various overdubs were completed for much of the material ultimately released on Western Stars, Twilight Hours, and the rest of Tracks II: The Lost Albums. A few new songs were also recorded at these sessions, including "September Kisses". The sessions took place throughout the period; we have combined them in this listing for convenience pending more specific information. During the preparation of Tracks II, Bruce came across "Janey Needs A Shooter" and, at some point, recorded it with the E Street Band for a possible Record Store Day release. He was so impressed by the result that he decided to hold onto it for a higher-profile occasion, which arrived on 2020's Letter To You; we have listed that session here for convenience, but its actual timing is unknown.

A special performance of Springsteen On Broadway, only for subscribers of SiriusXM satellite radio. The performance is not broadcast on SiriusXM, but subscribers have the opportunity to win tickets to the "private performance" through giveaways on SiriusXM's E Street Radio channel and through invitations sent by email. Subscribers could also enter a contest to win a trip to New York City, including airfare, hotel stay and a pair of tickets to the show. Among the audience were Howard Stern, Katy Perry, and Emmylou Harris.

Tonight Bruce deviates from the standard script. Before "Long Walk Home", he mentions the protest marches that took place in the afternoon in cities all over America. He called the march a powerful inspiration for young leaders of the future and an act President Trump could have learned from, but instead he took the weekend off "to fuckin' play golf in Florida."

2018-04-15 - WONDER BAR, ASBURY PARK, NJ

A surreal scene at the Wonder Bar in the afternoon. Bruce took his mother there to celebrate (in advance) her 93rd birthday and to see and play with The Eddie Testa Band. The band played six songs and Bruce did dance with his mom for a bit but then the power went out. It was a cold, rainy and windy day at the Jersey Shore. Bruce was definitely going to play, Kevin Buell was there with guitars. But the power never came back on. Bruce was there for more than 90 minutes. His son Sam was there also as were both of Patti's brothers. J.T. Bowen, a former member of Clarence Clemons's Red Bank Rockers, led the crowd in sing-alongs to "Stand By Me", "Under The Boardwalk", and "My Girl".

2018-04-21 - TRIBECA GRILL, NEW YORK CITY, NY

Bruce and Patti attend the 25th Kristen Ann Carr Fund (A Night To Remember). Also present were Steven Van Zandt, Roy Bittan, Jackson Browne, Dave Marsh, and Danny Clinch. Bruce did not perform.


2018-04-23 - BEACON THEATRE, NEW YORK CITY, NY

With Patti Smith and Her Band: BECAUSE THE NIGHT / PEOPLE HAVE THE POWER (with Michael Stipe and Jesse Smith)

Bruce joins Patti Smith and her band on stage during the Tribeca Film Festival. The occasion was the premiere of a new concert documentary about Smith, Horses: Patti Smith and Her Band. The film documents the Los Angeles concerts in January 2016 where Smith performed her album Horses to mark its 40th anniversary. Smith and band performed several hits, including "Dancing Barefoot" and "Gloria". After Smith introduced her band members, she said she had one more person to introduce. Bruce entered the stage to accompanied by a roaring of the crowd. Together, they performed "Because The Night" and the finale "People Have The Power", for which they were joined by Michael Stipe.

Soundcheck: MY HOMETOWN

MY HOMETOWN

Bruce performs live at Tony Awards, giving the American public a glimpse of "Springsteen on Broadway". After the full spoken introduction, he plays a drastically shortened version of "My Hometown" at the piano. Robert De Niro introduces the performance. Besides performing, Bruce also receives a Special Tony Award from Billy Joel.

2018-06-18 - ASBURY LANES, ASBURY PARK, NJ

ROCKIN' PNEUMONIA AND THE BOOGIE WOOGIE FLU / I JUST WANT TO MAKE LOVE TO YOU / DOWN THE ROAD APIECE / TWIST AND SHOUT

For the reopening of concert venue Asbury Lanes in his hometown Asbury Park, Bruce joins the Danny Clinch-led Tangiers Blues Band, which is sharing the bill with the Grammy-winning rock band Portugal. the Man. He joins the band midway through their performance for a four-song mini-set of blues standards. The event celebrates the multimillion-dollar renovation of Asbury's beloved shuttered bowling alley, newly outfitted as a music venue. Proceeds from the event will benefit the Boys and Girls Clubs of Monmouth County. Ticket are distributed by lottery and are available primarily to Asbury Park residents as part of the venue's commitment to honor the local community.


2018-06-19 - WALTER KERR THEATRE, NEW YORK CITY, NY

GROWIN' UP / MY HOMETOWN / MY FATHER'S HOUSE / THE WISH / THUNDER ROAD / THE PROMISED LAND / BORN IN THE U.S.A. / TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / TOUGHER THAN THE REST (with Patti Scialfa) / BRILLIANT DISGUISE (with Patti Scialfa) / THE GHOST OF TOM JOAD / THE RISING / DANCING IN THE DARK / LAND OF HOPE AND DREAMS / BORN TO RUN

Bruce breaks from the script to condemn the "inhumane" treatment of thousands of children who have been separated from their families by the hardline immigration policies of Donald Trump’s administration. Springsteen used this show to condemn "senior people in government" who he said "had blasphemed in suggesting that they had a duty to separate families." After a lengthy, unscripted condemnation, Springsteen told his audience: "For 146 shows, I have played pretty much the same set every night. Tonight demands something different." He then played a version of "The Ghost Of Tom Joad", replacing "Long Walk Home" (which is dropped for the first time on Broadway). Among the audience was singer Christina Aguilera.

After a long week break, Bruce returns to the Broadway stage, this time without Patti. As previous shows Bruce dropped "Long Walk Home" tonight for "The Ghost Of Tom Joad", which he normally does when Patti is not there. A special by-invitation-only performance of Springsteen on Broadway, filmed for release on Netflix. Two songs were added as an encore. Before continuing with "Long Time Comin'", Bruce told a story about the birth of Evan, his first son. It's also mentioned that Bruce played "Living Proof", but this would be a bit strange looking at the other Broadway performances, so it makes more sense that he played "Long Time Comin'".

2018-07-18 - MADISON SQUARE GARDEN, NEW YORK CITY, NY

TENTH AVENUE FREEZE-OUT / BORN TO RUN

Bruce shows up on stage at Billy Joel's 100th show at The Garden. Bruce sat down on Joel’s piano and performed "Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out". Next he grabbed his guitar and after a one-two count they launched into "Born To Run" with Joel backing him on the piano.
